payload.body: issue-0022 new head b3b51f6 (on 608a177), hv's two fixes as relayed. The hook, still inline in settings.json: path from stdin via jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' when command -v jq, else $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH; then strips "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/", because Claude Code passes absolute paths and MODULES.md lists relative ones, so without it every edit would warn; does nothing on an empty path; exit 0 always. Timeout 5. Checked by piping JSON into the command string: lib/nowhere.sh, relative and absolute, gives the advisory; lib/molt.sh (absolute) and liberators/web.sh (relative) give none; empty stdin gives none, and with CLAUDE_FILE_PATH=lib/nowhere.sh the advisory; no file_path key gives none; no jq on PATH gives none; rc 0 every time under bash, /bin/sh and dash. jq and prettier clean, gate on.
